How to read the scores

Scores run from 0 to 100, and higher is better. A category score is the weighted share of its checks that passed and of its measurements that scored well. The overall score is a weighted average of the categories that were measured.

  • 90 to 100 good
  • 50 to 89 needs improvement
  • 0 to 49 poor
Accessibility
Whether people who use a screen reader, keyboard, or other assistive technology can use the app. Measured by attest and Lighthouse in this run.
Performance
How quickly the page loads and becomes usable. Measured by Lighthouse in this run.
Responsiveness
How smoothly frames render and how fast the app reacts to input. Not measured in this run.
Memory
How much memory the app uses. Not measured in this run.
Best practices
General web practices such as HTTPS, console errors, and deprecated APIs. Measured by Lighthouse in this run.

Where the numbers come from:

  • attest 1.5.0: accessibility checks on the Flutter semantics tree, run from tests. Feeds Accessibility.
  • Lighthouse 13.5.0: Google's page audit, run in Chrome, for load performance, best practices, and accessibility. Feeds Accessibility, Performance and Best practices.
